notes: Pure digital protocol block; no analog reference / trim / calibration loop. Baud-rate is purely from a digital divider chain of the BusClock.
calibration_items: HS200/HS400 read-path tuning via SEND_TUNING_BLOCK (CMD21) to centre the sampling window.
Data Strobe (DS) skew alignment for HS400 DDR reads.
I/O driver strength selection (EXT_CSD DRIVER_STRENGTH) per board loading.
